description: Phase-CTX — Context Engineering Substrate. 6 stories (~+1050 LOC, ~3.5 sessions). Plan: .planning/post-drift-2026-05-21/Phase-CTX/plan.md. Builds the layered tool-output compression stack: OpenRouter model-metadata fetcher (NEW, was missing — drives the 50% compaction threshold) + ContextEngine ABC + ContextCompressor (hermes pattern) + payload_summarizer trait (openhuman pattern) + auto-compact at 50% of model context window (Codex pattern). 2026-05-24 USER LOCKED: compaction threshold MUST be 50% of the model context window fetched live from OpenRouter (LLM_BASE_URL = openrouter.ai), NOT a hard-coded env. Integration note: TokenJuice (internal/tokenjuice, already live) is layer-1 deterministic rule compactor; US-CTX-04 payload_summarizer is layer-2 LLM-based detour for non-matched oversize results. Both complement, not replace. Aura is AHEAD on layer-1 (semantic counters + porcelain rewriters) vs openhuman's dumb byte truncation, so the integration point is AFTER TokenJuice rules fail OR result still >threshold. Per-module deep refactor on touch mandatory per CLAUDE.md.

userStories.title: OpenRouter model metadata fetcher + ModelContextWindow config field (drives 50% trigger)
userStories.description: NEW story added 2026-05-24 after USER review of Phase-CTX plan: the compaction threshold MUST be 50% of the model context window fetched LIVE from OpenRouter (the production LLM provider for Aura — verified via curl http://localhost:18080/api/settings). Currently Aura has no plumbing for this: MaxContextTokens in config is the OUTPUT cap (max_tokens parameter), not the INPUT context window. This story adds an OpenRouter-aware metadata fetcher to internal/llm + a new config field cfg.ModelContextWindow populated at boot. US-CTX-04 then uses cfg.ModelContextWindow * 0.5 as its compaction trigger instead of a static env. Endpoint: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models returns data[].id + data[].context_length + data[].max_completion_tokens. Cache in-memory per model_id. Fallback table for provider non-OpenRouter or fetch failure: curated map[model_id]int with deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash=163840, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it=131072, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4=200000. Env override AURA_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOW (int) wins over both fetched + fallback (escape hatch).

userStories.notes: FOUNDATION for US-CTX-04. Without this, the 50% compaction trigger has nothing to compute against. The /models endpoint is OpenRouter-standard but not all providers expose it the same way — fallback table covers the curated set Aura supports (deepseek-v4-flash, gemma-4, claude-sonnet, etc). Env override is the escape hatch for any custom model not in the table. Boot path is non-blocking — fetch failure does NOT crash startup, just logs warn + uses fallback chain.

userStories.title: ContextCompressor with SUMMARY_PREFIX + scaled budget + tool-result pre-pruning
userStories.description: New internal/conversation/compressor.go implementing ContextEngine with hermes patterns (lifted verbatim from agent/context_compressor.py ~1000 LOC). (a) SUMMARY_PREFIX filter-safe summarizer preamble — the production-tested 451-char handoff prompt (every word load-bearing per R2). (b) Scaled summary budget: _MIN_SUMMARY_TOKENS=2000, _SUMMARY_RATIO=0.20, _SUMMARY_TOKENS_CEILING=12000 — formula: max(2000, min(content_tokens * 0.20, min(context_length * 0.05, 12000))). (c) Tool-result pre-pruning (deterministic 1-liner replacement: '[search_files] content search for X in agent/ -> 12 matches'). (d) JSON-arg sanitization preserving validity (recursively shrink string leaves to ≤200 chars; never produce invalid JSON — round-trips through json.Unmarshal). (e) Streaming context-tag scrubber that handles <memory-context>...</memory-context> split across SSE chunks (stateful FSM holding partial-tag tails). (f) Image-aware token budgeting (_IMAGE_TOKEN_ESTIMATE = 1600 per image_url part, matches Claude Code). _CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4.

userStories.title: payload_summarizer trait with threshold gating + circuit breaker (openhuman pattern)
userStories.description: Trait-based interception of oversized tool results BEFORE they enter agent history. INTEGRATION NOTE: this is layer-2 of the compression stack — sits AFTER internal/tokenjuice (already-live layer-1 rule compactor). Trigger only when TokenJuice rule fails OR rule-compacted output is still >threshold. PayloadSummarizer interface with MaybeSummarize(toolName, parentTaskHint, raw) returning *SummarizedPayload (nil = pass-through). Pass-through guards in EXACT order (lifted from openhuman harness/payload_summarizer.rs:55-310): (a) tokens < threshold_tokens → skip (no LLM call worth the round-trip), (b) tokens > max_payload_tokens → skip (too expensive, fall through to spill/truncation), (c) circuit breaker tripped (3 consecutive failures in session → disabled for rest of session), (d) summary length >= raw length → reject (summary didn't shrink, pass raw + record_failure), (e) parent-only scope (summarizer agent itself MUST get nil to prevent recursive dispatch — openhuman observed this in production and explicitly wires payload_summarizer=None for the summarizer agent definition). Token estimate `chars/4` (model-agnostic).

Pass-through guards in exact order: threshold check → max check → breaker check → dispatch → empty-summary check → summary>=raw check

userStories.title: AutoCompactEngine — token-budget compaction at 50% of model context window (replace 50-msg cap)
userStories.description: New ContextEngine implementation: AutoCompactEngine. Triggers compaction at 50% of model context window (USER LOCKED 2026-05-24 — overrides earlier 70% plan). Uses cfg.ModelContextWindow from US-CTX-00. Two-scope budget tracking lifted from codex core/src/session/turn.rs:655-705: `Total` (everything in prompt) vs `BodyAfterPrefix` (so overlays + initial-context stay 'free' against cache). Switches Aura's conversation cap semantics from message-count to token-budget. Replace MaxConversationMessages config (currently 50) with MaxConversationTokens (default = cfg.ModelContextWindow * 0.50 when AURA_CTX_COMPACT_PERCENT unset). Triggered inline mid-turn (NOT just pre-turn) with InitialContextInjection::BeforeLastUserMessage equivalent so the fresh user message survives the compaction. Source: Codex core/src/session/turn.rs:301-358 + :655-705. Online §3.2 — Anthropic effective context engineering 2026.
